_readme: Targets and commission for the dashboard. Every amount is NOK. 'commission' is what Naim earns once per deal, as discussed at the interview: CONFIRM in the written contract, then set confirmed to true. goal_deals_month is the monthly deal goal, daily_contacts the new companies to contact per weekday (emails + calls). assumptions are starting guesses in percent, used until there is enough real data (100 contacts, 5 meetings, 5 demos). sek_per_nok is a rough rate: update it now and then.
role: Sales rep, AI customer service for companies in Norway, commission only
